title: rhododendron × gandavense f. plenum
intro: Rhododendron × gandavense f. plenum, commonly known as the Plenum Rhododendron, is a hybrid plant species in the Rhododendron genus. It is known for its compact, rounded growth habit and vibrant, showy flowers in shades of pink and purple. The Plenum Rhododendron has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and supporting immune function.
